Meet the people behind Atomic.

Drasko Draskovic · Founder & CEO
Drasko Draskovic
Founder & CEO · Paris, France
Drasko Draskovic is the founder of Abstract Machines and the founder and CEO behind Atomic. A deep-tech entrepreneur and systems engineer, he brings more than 20 years of experience in IoT and cloud-computing systems. His background includes work at Texas Instruments, Alcatel-Lucent, Nokia, Sequans and Devialet. He co-founded Datapace as an internal venture at Nokia, where he served as CTO. His work spans open-source infrastructure and the identity, data and execution systems that support applications.
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/draskodraskovic/
X: https://x.com/draskodraskovic
Short bio
Drasko Draskovic is the founder of Abstract Machines and the founder and CEO behind Atomic. He is a systems engineer and entrepreneur with more than 20 years of experience in IoT and cloud computing.
Interview topics
Taking an app from a plain-language idea through Canvas editing to a reviewed release.
Why application identity, permissions and data matter in AI app building.
Source visibility and open-source infrastructure.

Dusan Borovcanin
Technical leadership
Dusan Borovcanin is Tech Lead at Abstract Machines, with more than 10 years of experience in distributed systems. His work includes confidential-computing infrastructure for AI and the engineering foundations behind Atomic. He previously built cocos-ai alongside Drasko Draskovic at Ultraviolet.

Filip Bugarski
Finance & Operations
Filip Bugarski coordinates and organizes company-wide operations at Ultraviolet, an Abstract Machines subsidiary focused on cybersecurity in Eastern Europe. He also oversees the financial operations of Abstract Machines France.
